recent.text: After one quarter, the Pistons have a 39-37 lead. Giannis Antetokounmpo leads the Heat with nine points, four rebounds and two assists. Klay Thompson is just behind him with eight points in the first 12 minutes.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: That's a great bit of hustle by Bam Adebayo. His sprint up the floor created the open corner 3 for Ryan Conwell and his continued effort after the Pistons grabbed the rebound created the steal for Bobby Portis.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: Myron Gardner's energy is undeniable, but also that has led to some moments of overzealous defense. Fouled Javonte Green on a 3-point attempt earlier and just helped too much, which left Duncan Robinson open for a corner 3. Pistons up, 28-27, with 3:19 left in the Q1.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: Pistons decided on a very small starting lineup tonight and it feels like they're trying to figure out how to defend Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo as they go along. Just made a really bad double on Adebayo that let Antetokounmpo run down the lane for a dunk.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: After missing last night's win with a sprained ankle, Klay Thompson already 2 of 2 on threes in the first 2:55.
recent.author: Anthony Chiang

recent.text: Two fouls for Ausar Thompson in the first 1:43. Heat have to take advantage of that being the case.
recent.author: Hot Hot Hoops

recent.text: Giannis Antetokounmpo just snapped a pass in between his legs like a long snapper for a corner 3 to Klay Thompson. You will see a few replays of it.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: Feels like a waste of a challenge from JB Bickerstaff so early in this game. Challenged a foul on Ausar Thompson against Giannis Antetokounmpo only 103 seconds into the game. Lost it.
recent.author: Eric Nehm

recent.text: Davion Mitchell took a forearm to the face diving for that loose ball — appears to be okay after shaking off the collision with Ausar Thompson. We love players who sacrifice for the greater good.
recent.author: Hot Hot Hoops

recent.text: Mitchell is staying in the game after getting checked out by the Heat's medical staff.
recent.author: Eric Nehm
recent.quoted_text: Davion Mitchell just dove for a loose ball and his head hit the floor hard. Ausar Thompson was called for a foul on the play, but that isn't going to make it feel any better.
